memories.content: For "count of code violations in 2025 by census tract" in Montgomery, AL, Fieldwork chose the dataset "Code Violations" (https://gis.montgomeryal.gov/server/rest/services/HostedDatasets/Code_Violations/FeatureServer/0): The code violations dataset is the only available candidate, offering census-tract-level violation counts updated in 2025.

For "count of code violations reported in 2026 by census tract" in Montgomery, AL, Fieldwork chose the dataset "Code Violations" (https://gis.montgomeryal.gov/server/rest/services/HostedDatasets/Code_Violations/FeatureServer/0): Same dataset an earlier run chose and checked (memory mem-20, confidence 0.87).

For "Count of code violations reported in 2026 by census tract" in Montgomery, AL, Fieldwork chose the dataset "Code Violations" (https://gis.montgomeryal.gov/server/rest/services/HostedDatasets/Code_Violations/FeatureServer/0): Same dataset an earlier run chose and checked (memory mem-2, confidence 0.79).

A working Zetaris join for "Which Montgomery census tracts have the highest adult asthma rates, and how many code violations were reported in each this year?": SELECT t.name AS tract_name, t.geoid, CAST(c.casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_rate, CAST(c.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS total_population, COALESCE(v.n, 0) AS code_violations_2026 FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t LEFT JOIN session.fw_<run>_m1_cdc AS c ON c.tractfips = t.geoid LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts AS v ON v.geoid = t.geoid AND v.run_id = '<run_id>' AND v.source = 'm2_city' AND v.grp = 'all' WHERE c.casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL ORDER BY adult_asthma_rate DESC LIMIT 50

A working Zetaris join for "Which Montgomery census tracts have the highest adult asthma rates, and how many code violations were reported in each this year?": SELECT t.name AS tract_name, t.geoid, CAST(c.casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_rate, CAST(c.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS population, COALESCE(v.n, 0) AS code_violations_2026 FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t LEFT JOIN session.fw_<run>_m1_cdc AS c ON c.tractfips = t.geoid LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts AS v ON v.geoid = t.geoid AND v.run_id = '<run_id>' AND v.source = 'm2_city' AND v.grp = 'all' WHERE c.casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL ORDER BY adult_asthma_rate DESC LIMIT 50
